title: Reduction of the Wagstaff Chebyshev sufficiency conjecture to the Pell Primitive Pair Conjecture
description: Reproducibility bundle for the paper. For W_p = (2^p + 1)/3 and omega_3 = 3 + 2*sqrt(2), the congruence omega_3^{(W_p+1)/2} = -1 (mod W_p) (Condition II) holds for every prime W_p; whether it implies primality is the open Wagstaff Chebyshev sufficiency conjecture, equivalently the open 'only if' direction of the Vrba-Reix Wagstaff primality test. The paper reduces the conjecture to the Pell Primitive Pair Conjecture together with a general-d nonexistence-of-compatible-triples (NCT) statement and a mild Wieferich-Wagstaff exclusion, and proves NCT unconditionally for every odd d <= 200 and at fifteen further parity-unblocked values in (200, 400]. This bundle contains the LaTeX source, the reproducibility scripts, and static NCT fixed-d certificates (pinned Psi_{4d} factorizations, APR-CL certified).
